posts.name: Pammi Tiwari
posts.cooked:
Respected Sir, @sayan
I just wanted to clarify if my solution for OOPE_2.1 is correct or if I have done it wrong.My public cases passed but my private case was not passing.

image605×230 4.4 KB

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
This solution works, and will pass private test cases as well.

Screenshot 2025-08-26 at 13.23.431218×2146 176 KB

However your last submission is something else:

Screenshot 2025-08-26 at 13.27.031598×2066 172 KB

This does not pass private test case as the shell can contain other characters as well.

Simple solution:

#!/usr/bin/env bash

while read -r line; do
    shell=${line##*/}
    echo "${shell^^}"
done
